user.title: Find your school
user.description: Type the name or the town of the school (Skolengo ENT).

provider.title: How do you sign in?
provider.description: Choose the account you use on the ENT of {school}. Parents and students usually sign in with EduConnect of their académie.

method.title: Sign-in method
method.description: The integration can sign in for you with your login and password, without a browser. Use the browser method if you sign in with FranceConnect or if a captcha is asked.

credentials.title: Sign in
credentials.description: Your EduConnect (or ENT) login and password for {school}. The password is used once to sign in and is not stored; only the session is kept.

browser.title: Sign in in your browser
browser.description:
1. On a computer, open the developer tools of your browser (F12) on the **Console** tab.
2. Open [this sign-in link]({auth_url}) in the same tab and sign in as usual.
3. At the end the browser cannot open an address starting with `skoapp-prod://sign-in-callback`: copy that whole address from the console (Chrome: *Failed to launch 'skoapp-prod://…'*) and paste it below **within a minute**.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Skolengo session for {school} has expired or was revoked. Sign in again to keep your data up to date.

error.no_school_found: No school found. Try the town or another spelling.
error.captcha_required: EduConnect asks for a captcha. Sign in once on the ENT website in a browser, then try again, or use the browser method.
error.unknown_provider: This account type is no longer offered by the ENT. Start again.
error.login_failed: The sign-in stopped on an unexpected page (maintenance?). Try again later or use the browser method.
error.code_expired: The pasted address has expired or was already used. Use the new link and paste the address faster.
error.invalid_callback: This is not a valid address starting with skoapp-prod://sign-in-callback.

abort.wrong_account: You signed in with another account than the one of this entry.

homework_not_found.message: Homework {uid} is not in the list any more; refresh and try again.

homework_forbidden.message: The ENT does not allow this account to mark homework as done.

auth_expired.message: The Skolengo session has expired; sign in again.
